question:
Choose the word that is opposite in meaning to the given word.

Algid
solution:
The correct answer is **'Option 3'** i.e. **'Igneous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• The word that is opposite in meaning to **"algid" **is** "igneous".**
 
• **"Algid"** is an adjective that refers to being cold or chilly.(ठंडा)
 
• It is often used to describe very cold conditions.
 
• **"Igneous" **- "Igneous" is a term used in geology to refer to rock or material formed from solidification of molten or partly molten material, implying the involvement of heat.(आग्नेय)
 
• It can symbolize the opposite of **"algid,"** which means cold.

Therefore, the **correct answer** is: **'Igneous'.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• Let's examine the other words:
 
 
• **"Algae" **- "Algae" is a simple, non-flowering, aquatic plant of a large group that includes seaweeds and many single-celled forms. (शैवाल)
 
• **"Gelid" **- "Gelid" is an adjective that refers to icy or extremely cold.(हिममय)
 
• **"Clean"** - "Clean" is an adjective that refers to being free from dirt, marks, or stains.(साफ़)
